projects.name: Game Cabinet
projects.summary: Tiny games, one cabinet. An iOS app of small, quick games from 12 Acre Films.
notes: Games so far: Kessler (endless satellite launch and orbit) and Waterfuls.
Scores are stored on the device only. No personal data is collected.

projects.name: pxlstream
projects.summary: Create a photo and video log of everything in your home. Save an inventory of your home before disaster deletes it.
notes: Exploring a rename and a modular architecture so other apps (rentals, landlords, stock tracking) can sit under one parent brand.
Candidate parent names: Talix, Tallie, Talli, Tallee.
Applying to the WTIA Founder Cohort, Oct 2026.
